posts.title: Teaching a 14B Model to Talk Like otisabi: An SFT Style Transfer Experiment
posts.description: I wanted to fine-tune a small LLM to write like a specific person. Not a generic “write in a funny tone” — I wanted it to mimic a real writer’s voice. I picked otisabi , a veteran writer on ekşi sözlük with nearly 14,000 entries and a distinctive style. For those unfamiliar: ekşi sözlük is Turkey’s iconic collaborative dictionary, founded in 1999 — years before Urban Dictionary or Reddit existed.
